final: WITH pair_avgs AS (SELECT tr.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(tr.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS tr JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON tr.transref = x.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON x.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), deviations AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt, ABS(p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pair_avgs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT *, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), selected AS (SELECT *, deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS average_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM selected GROUP BY tradekind
